current_decision.reason: A beta primitive would be a Higgs-specific parameter and should be avoided until the UV two-Higgs source and intrinsic H-row routes are exhausted.

forbidden_if: set to tan_beta=10 because older text used it as a representative value
backsolved from m_H, lambda_H, v, or measured weak angle
hidden inside threshold or RG matching constants
may_be_used_only_if: declared once before any Higgs-mass/lambda comparison
not chosen from observed Higgs mass, observed vev, SM-parity lambda, or RG benchmark targets
not retuned per observable, scale, or paper
all downstream lambda_H statements display dependence on beta_H until a theorem derives it
falsifiable by mismatch with other Higgs/EW observables after the same fixed value is used

superset_strategy.conditional_path: hold beta_H as an explicit primitive policy, not yet instantiated
superset_strategy.intrinsic_escape_path: derive K_H^(4)[12,12,12,12] and avoid D-term beta entirely
superset_strategy.strict_path: derive beta/tan_beta from selected UV two-Higgs projection or decoupling geometry
